bands.title: Absolute beginner
bands.scope: Computers, instructions, input and output; files and folders; browsers; a first HTML page; tiny CSS rules; named values and console output.

bands.title: Beginner
bands.scope: Values, types and step-by-step reasoning; accessible page structure and forms; CSS layout; JavaScript operators, conditions and first functions; reading errors.

bands.title: Advanced beginner
bands.scope: Loops, functions, arrays and objects; the DOM and events; form validation; responsive layout; small repeatable debugging steps.

bands.title: Early intermediate
bands.scope: Organized browser state, JSON and local storage; events and asynchronous introductions; request and response basics; a minimal Manifest V3 extension; desktop processes.

bands.title: Intermediate
bands.scope: Promises, async/await, fetch and failures; extension messages and permissions; a queued text-to-speech reader; Web Audio fundamentals; safe local Windows tools.

bands.title: Strong intermediate
bands.scope: Python from its first print and variable; conditions, loops, functions and collections; files and JSON; compare Python with familiar JavaScript; desktop UI and dashboard inputs.

bands.title: Early advanced
bands.scope: Python modules, files, errors and data transformations; stock prices, volume and percentage calculations; caching, API limits and live browser state; portable tools.

bands.title: Advanced
bands.scope: Testable Python and JavaScript; WebSockets and reconnects; workers and cancellation; frontend/backend boundaries; SQLite; safe PowerShell and packaging.

bands.title: Very advanced
bands.scope: Connect extensions, TTS, screeners and applets into complete projects; state machines, bounded queues, security, schema checks, concurrency, accessibility and repeatable performance measurement.

bands.title: Professional practical knowledge
bands.scope: End-to-end design and failure diagnosis; reliable extension/TTS lifecycles; screener stream recovery; application migrations and releases; profiling, observability, threat boundaries and maintainable complete applications.

ordering: Ten related cards per carefully authored micro-lesson. Preserve concept order inside each band; revisit foundations from several angles. New cards are strictly 1 through 5000. Insert already-studied due reviews without skipping unseen prerequisites.
review: Wrong answers return after a few completed cards. Correct answers move to longer day intervals. Each course-week ends with a review of studied, weak, hesitant and foundational cards. No calendar rollover resets completion.
mastery: Mastery requires repeated correct reviews on separate days and at least a week of elapsed learning. A wrong answer makes a card weak again.
